records.generatedCopy: Claude Code 2.1.296 now lets a custom subagent compact earlier than its parent with autoCompactWindow. A smaller window is useful only when critical state survives compaction. This checklist shows how to choose suitable workers, maintain a compact-safe evidence ledger, run planted-marker canaries against an unchanged-window control, and gate rollout on quality plus accepted-result cost. It is a rollout control, not proof of lower token use or better answers.
